Investors are reading the rebound in futures as a reluctant embrace of higher for longer rates. The October CPI report showed headline prices up 0.4% month on month and core inflation at 0.3%. Those figures, alongside hawkish recent Fed comments, keep a December move of at least 25 bp firmly on the table...
